name: gpcr_spa_cryo_em_pipeline
description: Standard cryo-EM single-particle analysis for GPCR and membrane protein complexes in nanodiscs / detergent micelles. Uses the GPCR Complex SPA workflow optimized for 0.83 A/pix at 100-150 kDa complexes, then 3D variability or focused refinement to resolve conformational states. Sequence: import movies / standard SPA → GPCR-specific SPA → conformational heterogeneity analysis.
example_queries: GPCR cryo-EM single particle analysis in nanodisc
membrane protein structure determination by cryo-EM
